# NanoPi R6S / RK3588S NPU driver port for OpenWrt

> Experimental Rockchip RKNPU 0.9.8 R10 port for Linux 6.12.112 on the FriendlyElec NanoPi R6S (RK3588S, AArch64), with three-core device-tree and IOMMU integration, OpenWrt packaging and optional private GNU runtime recipes.

The project was motivated by exploring Kitsune / KitNET-inspired network anomaly
detection on a router's NPU. The application implementation, models, proprietary
RKNN SDK and firmware binaries are outside this source repository.

The initial source passed isolated OpenWrt and GNU runtime builds on 2026-10-11.
Later error-path corrections passed host fault-injection tests and a separate
module build. Earlier hardware bring-up is recorded separately. Strict numerical comparison
has not passed; detection accuracy, NPU speedup, cold boot, service activation
and a complete endurance run are not certified. This is an experimental port,
not a reproduced Kitsune evaluation or a complete intrusion-detection product.

## Overview and evidence

- [Error-path review](docs/ERROR_PATH_REVIEW.md): Four accepted findings, fixes, regression tests and remaining kernel/device limits.
- [README](README.md): Motivation, scope, hardware and software baseline.
- [Validation](docs/VALIDATION.md): Recorded hardware evidence, new build checks and remaining limits.
- [Dated results](verification/results-2026-10-11.json): Machine-readable build checks and artifact hashes.
- [Project metadata](repo-metadata.jsonld): Schema.org SoftwareSourceCode description and research citation.

## Build and integration

- [Build instructions](docs/BUILD.md): Pinned OpenWrt baseline and module integration.
- [Isolated verification](verification/README.md): Disposable AArch64 Linux environment and minimal build.
- [Port design](docs/PORTING.md): Driver, IOMMU and three-core device-tree changes.
- [GNU runtime](runtime/README.md): Optional private loader and library preparation, build and synthetic checks.
